title: Width bound for the width-three-CNF encoding
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits. The maximum number of literals in any clause of its width-three CNF encoding is at most $3$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit with input dimension n
